options.name: Schema map
options.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one polished, original square icon concept for a developer extension named DBML Diagrams, an offline tool that turns database schema code into interactive entity-relationship diagrams. This is an icon design exploration, not a screenshot. Center a bold, simple symbol with balanced negative space. Make the design legible at 32x32 and attractive at large size. Square 1:1 canvas, opaque background, crisp geometry, strong silhouette. No written words, no slogans, no labels, no watermark, no brand logos, no fake UI, no borders outside the icon. Produce exactly one icon, not a grid, collage, or presentation board. A precise flat geometric mark: three compact database table cards connected by thick right-angle relationship lines, one central card with two satellite cards. Indigo background, clean white card bodies with small electric-blue header accents. Each card has only two thick short horizontal row marks, avoiding tiny detail. Restrained, confident developer-tool identity.
